services.label: Cloudflare
services.desc: DNS for example.test, the DNS-01 challenge behind every certificate, the public resolvers, and the tunnel.
services.breaks: Now: the tunnel goes dark; once cached answers expire, no *.example.test name resolves. At the next renewal: no certificate is issued.

uses.label: resolves *.example.test
uses.why: Name resolution is not in any file: the zone lives in Cloudflare

services.label: Let's Encrypt
services.breaks: At renewal: no new certificates; the current ones last up to 90 days.

services.label: Docker Hub
services.breaks: At the next deploy: a new tag or a fresh machine cannot pull.

services.label: GitHub Container Registry
services.breaks: At the next deploy: no new versions.

services.label: npm registry
services.desc: npm ci in the API image and in CI.
services.breaks: A dependency change cannot deploy; CI fails.

services.label: GitHub
services.breaks: CI cannot start, so nothing merges.

services.label: Google Fonts
services.desc: The shop's web font, fetched by the visitor's browser.

services.label: Nominatim
services.desc: OpenStreetMap's address search, behind the API's geo search.

services.label: Web Push
services.desc: The browsers' push services, which carry reminders to phones.

uses.label: sends web push
uses.why: Each push endpoint comes from a subscription at run time, not from a file

services.label: Tailscale
services.desc: The tailnet every machine and phone joins.
services.breaks: Now: phones away from home cannot reach the tailnet-only sites.

services.label: Internet provider
services.breaks: Everything outside at once; the LAN keeps working.

services.label: Domain registrar
services.desc: Where example.test is registered; its nameservers point at Cloudflare.
services.breaks: At renewal: a lapsed registration takes every name down.

uses.label: the zone is delegated to it
uses.why: Registration is an account, not code

services.label: Email relay
services.desc: An SMTP relay, not set up yet.

plan.note: none today; one may be added later

web.label: Public web
web.desc: Any public page a person points the API at.
web.breaks: One page down: that one import fails and is retried.

links.why: A link a person follows from the shop; never fetched
